summary: An instance seat's Claude status-line hook now looks for statusline-renderer.json in the instance's own Claude folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) instead of the person's default ~/.claude, so an instance no longer picks up the person's renderer. A default install still reads ~/.claude/statusline-renderer.json, and ST_CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_RENDERER still wins over the file in both cases.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: Only which file the hook reads for an instance seat changes; the file's shape and the hook's contract are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart is needed beyond the usual daemon upgrade; a running Claude picks the change up on its next status-line call.

manual.detail: A person who wants a renderer in an instance puts statusline-renderer.json in that instance's Claude folder or sets ST_CLAUDE_STATUSLINE_RENDERER.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; the hook reads ~/.claude again.
